name: 33444 · Delray Beach, FL
findings: ZIP 33444 (Delray Beach) has 159 nonprofit organizations. 56 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 38 organizations.
Community organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33444 (Delray Beach) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
66% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 33444 (Delray Beach) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.9 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 38 organizations here; 72% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
